q: At least 2 years of relevant experience in accounting within IT Enterprise.
r: Review, input and control daily entries and transactions on the system and ensure all supporting documents are properly classified
Handle, process and track various payments based on internal approvals through agreed on payment methods
Complete journal entries and ensure proper reconciliation of accounts

d: Build a career rich with potential.

Some careers grow faster than others. If you’re looking for a role that offers opportunities to develop, broaden your experience and take your career in an exciting new direction, join HSBC. We provide opportunities, support and rewards to help you take your career further.

This position sits within HSBC Markets Treasury (MKTY), the street-facing arm of the Treasury function. MKTY is responsible for managing cash, funding, liquidity and interest rate risks that underpin HSBC Oman’s objective of achieving profitability. You will play a pivotal role in delivering Markets Treasury initiatives within the Oman market, while ensuring that the business operates within its agreed risk appetite and in full compliance with HSBC Group and regulatory requirements.
q: Strong business and financial markets knowledge is required.
Commercially driven and the ability work under dynamic market conditions will be an advantage.
Knowledge of technology development and infrastructure, including how technology can be used to meet business needs.
Strong communication skills and the confidence to engage with colleagues and senior management.
The ability to manage and mitigate operational risk effectively.
Experience working in a diverse and geographically dispersed team.
Knowledge of the external environment, including regulatory, political, competitor and market developments would be an advantage.
Priority will be given to Omani Nationals.

At HSBC, you’ll work in a collaborative and inclusive environment where different perspectives are valued. You’ll have the opportunity to work across borders, develop your expertise and contribute to a business that connects clients and markets across the region and globally.
If you’re ready to take responsibility, get things done and help shape the future of Markets Treasury, we’d like to hear from you.
r: Managing cash to ensure surplus funds are deployed and deficits are financed on the best available terms for the bank.
Executing and completing short- and medium-term funding plans on behalf of the bank and entity.
Managing liquidity to ensure the bank or entity can meet its current and potential cash-flow obligations at a reasonable cost, without incurring significant commercial or reputational risk.
Managing the entity’s Liquid Asset Buffer (LAB) within the risk appetite defined by the LAB Committee, ensuring it remains available for monetisation during stress scenarios.
Hedging / Managing interest rate risk in the banking book (IRRBB) using Financial Markets instruments.
Supporting the development and maintenance of effective governance structures, processes and controls that meet HSBC Group standards.

Supporting delivery of the annual Global Performance Scorecard, including financial targets such as revenue, costs and risk-weighted assets, as well as non-financial obligations relating to liquidity risk management, conduct and operational risk.
Ensuring the business operates within agreed risk appetite and complies fully with Group policies, procedures and regulatory requirements.
Championing transformation and change initiatives, from execution through to effective embedding across the business.
Undertaking analytics and providing accurate, timely data to support informed decision-making.
